blockId.description: Structural and visual block assignment. 0 is air; non-zero ids resolve through blockRegistry.

elementalMatrix.description: Localized magic traits packed into Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, Holy, and Dark bit masks.

metadataFlags.description: Physical and runtime-render flags. OBSTRUCTION_HIDING marks structural voxels eligible for vertical Z-axis dual-zone viewport culling. Environment terrain must never carry this flag.
